item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"row_count","expression":"len(output_token_ids)","rationale":"Captures per-row traversal and tensor conversion overhead."},{"name":"token_count","expression":"sum(len(row) for row in output_token_ids)","rationale":"Captures work reading and converting existing token IDs."},{"name":"padded_elements","expression":"len(output_token_ids) * max((len(row) for row in output_token_ids), default=0)","rationale":"Captures rectangular tensor allocation, padding, and initialization work."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is approximately fixed overhead plus linear costs in row count, existing token count, and padded tensor size."}
